notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Ulasht.
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
